messages:
Sam (AE): Quick sync for Velora Health POC. They want a short pilot to validate triage + encounter summarization + med/allergy extraction. Ask from customer: clear success criteria, prioritized endpoints, sample prompts/evals, rough perf/cost tradeoffs, and whether Private deployment needed. Proposed pilot window: May 5 1-> May 30 (4w). Can SE + Security jump on a triage call?

Nina (Solutions Eng): Happy to lead technical scoping. Suggested MVP endpoints (ordered by impact):
1) Urgency triage (binary + category)
2) Encounter summarization (concise SOAP-style summary)
3) Structured extraction (meds, allergies, vitals)
4) Draft reply templates for clinicians (optional)

Nina (Solutions Eng): Perf/traffic assumptions I used for sizing:
- Triage: 120 requests/min peak, median payload ~180 tokens, expected 40 tokens out. Goal: p95 <250ms for hosted; p99 <120ms requires Dedicated.
- Summaries: 25 reqs/hour, avg 1800 tokens input. Streaming required to keep UX smooth.

Nina (Solutions Eng): Example prompt prototypes we'll use for eval set (we'll craft ~200 triage cases, 50 gold summaries, 100 extraction samples):
```
# triage example
Clinical note: "48yo F with persistent cough, fever 101F, O2 sat 95%."
Task: label urgency: [routine, ASAP, emergency]
# summary example
Input: <full encounter note>
Instruction: Produce a 3-sentence problem-focused summary with assessment and plan.
```
Success targets: triage recall on emergency >= 0.9, extraction F1 >= 0.88, clinician usefulness median >= 4/5 for summaries.

Carlos (Customer Eng): Integration checklist from Velora side:
- EHR: FHIR R4 endpoints accessible from our integration service
- Wants pre-send pseudonymization script (we can run in their VPC)
- Async workflow: POST job -> webhook to internal callback URL when done
- Metadata required: patient_hash, encounter_hash, source_system (no raw PHI in logs)

Lina (Security): Initial security constraints:
- Must support TLS1.2+ and customer-provided KMS for any persisted artifacts
- No persistent caches of raw patient text for POC; must be able to disable prefix/KV caches per-customer
- Audit logging with configurable retention; customer requested 12 months
- BAA required; we need legal to confirm but security ops is OK to proceed with standard path

Lina (Security): Questions for SE:
- Will transient KV cache be used for summaries? If so, we need to show how we isolate and flush on demand.
- Do our hosted logs redact tokens or entire payloads? Need to provide a sample log snippet for Velora review.

Sam (AE): Pricing ask from Velora: compare hosted per-token vs Dedicated reserved estimate. They gave annualized forecast: monthly ~150M tokens. Also want min committed term for Dedicated and whether pilot can run on Dedicated test node.

Nina (Solutions Eng): Ballpark cost notes (very rough):
- Hosted: typical medium gen ~ $0.00055 per token for long-form summaries (placeholder)
- Dedicated: 1x mid-tier GPU pool could cover p99 latency needs; recommend a 6-week pilot on Dedicated trial node to validate p99 and streaming behavior before committing.
- I'll follow up with infra for a more accurate estimate and instance sizing.

Jordan (Product): Proposed acceptance criteria (for AE to present to customer):
- Triage: emergency recall >= 0.9 AND end-to-end latency median <200ms
- Extraction: entity F1 >= 0.88 on 100-sample gold set
- Summary: clinician usefulness >= 4/5 on 50-sample blind review
- Integration: webhooks delivered >= 99% during pilot window
If met, propose move to 3-6 month reserved capacity discussion.

Nina (Solutions Eng): Operational controls we should document for Velora:
- How to disable KV/prefix caching and scrub cache on demand
- Options for BYOK and VPC peering (Private only)
- Client-side pseudonymizer script (we'll supply)

Infra Bot: infra-note: No infra change scheduled. To request Dedicated test node, open ticket with tags: sales-poc, dedicated-test, velora.

Lina (Security): I'll prepare a short security FAQ plus a "POC controls" checklist covering BYOK, VPC peering, no-cache flag, log redaction, audit retention. Draft due Tue.

Sam (AE): Next actions / owners:
- Nina: final eval prompts + sample dataset (triage 200 / extract 100 / summary 50) by Tue EOD
- Lina: security FAQ + POC checklist by Tue EOD
- Carlos: integration runbook + pseudonymizer stub by Wed
- Jordan: acceptance criteria doc for customer (one-pager) by Wed
- Sam: schedule kickoff w/ Velora for May 6 onboarding call once we have prompt set

Carlos (Customer Eng): I'll include a small Dockerized pseudonymizer and instructions for running it in their network. Will also document required callback schema.

Sam (AE): Great. I'll loop in legal for BAA and start a hosted vs Dedicated cost comparison to share in the next sales call. :thumbsup:
